name: Romania

facts.religion: Orthodox Christian about 85%, Catholic and Protestant minorities

snapshot: Spending cuts to tame the EU's biggest budget deficit tipped Romania into recession in 2026 and strained the coalition, as the far-right AUR waits in the wings.
culture: Romanian is a Romance language surrounded by Slavic and Hungarian neighbours, a source of national pride. The painted monasteries of Bucovina, the castles of Transylvania and the Danube Delta draw visitors. Brâncuși transformed modern sculpture. Doinas, lyrical folk songs, are UNESCO-listed. A large Hungarian minority lives in Transylvania.
society: Romania has grown fast since joining the EU in 2007, with a strong IT sector, but millions have emigrated. In 2024 the Constitutional Court annulled a presidential election after a far-right outsider, Călin Georgescu, surged amid alleged Russian interference on TikTok. Nicușor Dan, Bucharest's centrist mayor, won the 2025 rerun.
situation: In December 2024 Romania's Constitutional Court annulled a presidential election after a little-known far-right candidate, Călin Georgescu, surged to first place on a TikTok campaign that intelligence services linked to Russia. In the rerun, the pro-European mayor of Bucharest, Nicușor Dan, won. Romania had escaped a populist takeover, but it was left with the EU's biggest budget deficit, over 9 percent of GDP, and someone had to fix it.

That job fell to Ilie Bolojan, a famously frugal former mayor who became prime minister in June 2025 at the head of a four-party pro-EU coalition. He raised taxes, froze public wages and pensions, and cut state jobs, bringing the deficit down from 9.3 to 7.9 percent (GlobalPost). The cuts tipped the economy into recession in the first quarter of 2026. They also hit the patronage networks of the Social Democrats (PSD), the coalition's largest party, whose voters were drifting to the far-right AUR. "Our members have become targets on the street because we are seen as the enablers of those who cut, close, and fire," said PSD leader Sorin Grindeanu (Radio Moldova/Digi24). The PSD quit on 23 April, then on 5 May joined the far right in a no-confidence vote that toppled Bolojan after ten months, even though polls showed him the coalition's most popular politician. The leu hit a record low. On 4 June President Dan nominated his adviser Eugen Tomac as prime minister (wiiw). About €16 billion in EU recovery funds depended on reforms by 31 August.
power: A semi-presidential republic. The directly elected president, limited to two five-year terms, nominates the prime minister and leads on defence and foreign policy; the government needs the confidence of the bicameral parliament. The next parliamentary election is due in 2028.
holders: President Nicușor Dan, since May 2025; Prime Minister Luca Niculescu, confirmed by parliament on 20 October 2026 after months of deadlock.

update.html: On 20 October parliament confirmed Luca Niculescu as prime minister, ending months of political deadlock over the coalition and its austerity programme.

sources.label: Reuters: Romanian parliament confirms new prime minister
